origin_story_and_build_history.title: The Evolution of MJ: From Script to Jarvis-Grade Ecosystem
origin_story_and_build_history.total_development_timeline: Built and iteratively evolved across 6 intensive engineering phases (October 11 to October 16, 2026).
origin_story_and_build_history.how_mj_was_built: MJ was conceived and engineered by Noaman. Initially started as a basic command-line script with rigid regex checks, MJ was completely re-architected into a true autonomous desktop and mobile Jarvis ecosystem powered by Gemini AI, Windows native API controllers, Python self-healing engines, CustomTkinter holographic UI, and a native Kotlin Jetpack Compose Android app with Accessibility and Telecom superpowers.

milestones.summary: Setup of initial assistant foundation, app launcher, volume control, basic web searching, and setting core rule: Always address Noaman, assistant is MJ, speak in natural Hinglish without formal greetings.

Noaman identified key bottlenecks: YouTube only opening search page instead of playing, WhatsApp messaging hanging on 'kaam shuru hai', phone calling not dialling, and desired voice clone of ElevenLabs Swati S.

Engineered full solutions: YouTube direct video ID autoplay, two-turn conversational WhatsApp messaging, Windows Phone Link dialer, Autonomous Task Executor with self-correcting Python script synthesis ('har kaam karke dena'), Self-Extending Skills Library, Diagnostics Doctor with multi-solution options, and Privacy Vault with secret passphrase.

Built standalone CustomTkinter dark neon desktop UI (MJ_Assistant.pyw), 1-click launcher (Launch_MJ.bat), PyInstaller packaging (build_app.bat), and containerized Docker setup (Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml).

milestones.phase: Phase 5: Voice Glitch Resolution & Hinglish Normalizer (Oct 15, 2026)
milestones.summary: Resolved robotic male 'admin' voice glitch by upgrading edge-tts to 7.3.1 to fix Microsoft's Sec-MS-GEC 403 error, locked offline fallback to female voices (Zira/Hazel), and built Hinglish Pronunciation Normalizer (Noaman -> 'नोमान', RAM -> 'रैम', CPU -> 'सी.पी.यू.').

milestones.phase: Phase 6: Mobile Evolution — Smart Dual-Mode Android App (Oct 16, 2026)
milestones.summary: Built native Android application in mobile/android/ combining Standalone 4G/5G mode (independent of laptop) with Jarvis Laptop Bridge (local Wi-Fi auto-discovery), featuring direct CALL_PHONE dialing without green button, zero-touch automated WhatsApp messaging via AccessibilityService, and 24/7 background pocket listening.
